manifestLastResortFallback.status: guarded only because dq-tiles.js explicitly uses manifest startCell when live landmark table is unavailable

authoredKeepoutMetadata.savedOverworldResumePolicy: Saved overworld positions are dynamic resume candidates, not permanent map-wide exclusions; final full-hero collision clearance must validate each candidate.
authoredKeepoutMetadata.routePolicy: No permanent road/route cutouts. Current manifest art-space points and semanticCells are obsolete fixtures; any BFS witness is verification evidence only.
authoredKeepoutMetadata.sampling: All alpha>8 frames from both selectable 64x64 hero sheets, mapped at source-approved world scale, stamped at each current live exit, each seedWalkableAt-valid cardinal neighbor of a live door, current new-game exit, and actual manifest last-resort fallback; includes one art-pixel cardinal movement margin.

coordinateContract.placementTransform: whole source crop at fixed atlas group normalization; one global binary-alpha threshold of >=128 per normalized source object; no rotation/mirror/instance scale; chunks are only adjacent delivery crops

stageComposition.baseReplacementRule: Latest forest-stage base is the merge base. Within exact owner M plus existing R6 solid-rock support outside M, excluding only current-runtime live start/exits/valid approaches and the dq-tiles.js manifest last-resort fallback, replace base pixels with clean canonical R4 render_window material output. Then apply same-phase meadow RGB only at alpha-zero, forest-alpha<=16 pixels in the two-cell owner-M edge band, plus exact owner-M portions of live-guard stencils with alpha zero and forest-alpha<=16. Actual visible forest canopy retains its latest base underneath; exposed gaps use meadow floor. Outside these exact masks the latest forest base remains source input. No stale manifest route cutouts, no old R4 art-space route strokes, and no old mountain paint_contact.

maskSourceBasis.terrainRows: candidate owner-terrain.json ACT1 owner classes M/F only

pairedFootGround.selectionRule: Actual alpha-derived exposed surfaces only: alpha-zero, canopy-alpha<=16 owner M/F pixels in exact-support transparent components that touch both outside-support and visible-rock boundaries, plus alpha-zero/canopy-free owner M/F components touching both visible-rock and actual-canopy boundaries. No cell-distance cutoff. Water and solid-object layers are untouched; closed interior component 36 at world cell (151,246) is explicitly excluded.

closedInteriorConcavity.supportConnectivity: closed; not connected to outside support

protectedLiveGuardGroundAudit.candidateCriterion: Current runtime protected full-hero start/exit/valid-approach/fallback stencil AND owner-M AND alpha-zero, RGB spread <=20 and mean 40..175 in latest forest-stage base.
protectedLiveGuardGroundAudit.masks: Per-chunk exact diagnostic masks at patches/protected-gray-live-guard-mask; these describe latest-base pixels before the paired underpaint correction.

stageComposition.keepoutExclusion: Current executed live API start, eight exits, 11 seedWalkableAt-valid door neighbors, and dq-tiles.js manifest last-resort fallback. No permanent mask is generated from stale manifest route paths or generic recovery candidates.

pixelAudit.maskPurpose: Visible alpha>=128 only; no invisible/barrier geometry is emitted.

runtimeCollisionMapping.currentAuthority: candidate public/act1-overworld-walk.bin; A1OW v1, 48 game pixels per map cell, 320x400 sparse cells with 48x48 block bytes, baked by scripts/bake_act1_overworld_walk.mjs. public/dq-tiles.js::owmBuild/owmTileBlock currently combines water and tile4 mountainField; public/act1-hifi/manifest.json collision points to QOK forest-collision.bin, which is forest-only.
runtimeCollisionMapping.proposedReplacement: Within active ACT1 plate only, preserve existing water and bridge bits. Remove tile4-generated mountain obstacle contribution only inside the active mountain-painted bounds, then derive the replacement mountain-solid contribution from this stage visible-alpha bitmap (threshold 128) mapped from 32 art px/cell to the A1OW 48 px/cell occupancy grid. Recompute full-hero clearance/distance while retaining water and protected route/cave/landmark behavior. Keep Acts 2–5, non-ACT1 tile4 handling, and dungeon collision unchanged. Treat QOK forest collision as an independent layer; do not mistake it for mountain/A1OW replacement.

limitations: This is a staged artifact and collision-source proposal, not candidate/runtime integration.
The 32px/cell visible-alpha fit is audited against exact support and authored hero guards; final A1OW whole-hero movement re-bake and active gameplay remain integration-owner checks.
